items.title: How a KDF's cost parameter reshapes an attacker's total campaign time
items.description: An illustrative model, back-derived from this unit's own measured scrypt timings (3.7ms at N=2^10, roughly doubling in cost per costLog step). One real login always pays this same per-guess cost exactly once — at the default setting that's under a tenth of a second, and even at the highest setting shown it's still under 4 seconds. Drag the cost parameter and the attacker's guess count to see how those same milliseconds compound into days or years once paid billions of times over.
items.compute: const loginTimeMs = 3.7 * Math.pow(2, params.costLog - 10); const attackerDays = (loginTimeMs * params.numGuessesBillions * 1e9) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24); return { attackerDays: Math.round(attackerDays * 10) / 10 };
